#container {
 opacity: .85;
}

Is the minimum code you need. To make it look more fancy use:

#container {
 opacity: .85;
 transition: opacity .25s ease-in-out;
 -moz-transition: opacity .25s ease-in-out;
 -webkit-transition: opacity .25s ease-in-out;
}

#container:hover {
 opacity: .98;
}

85% is the default opacity, 98% is the opacity when the mouse is hovering over the main window. You can change the values to get the desired look.
